dinner.signed_up_message: Your spot at the course dinner is guaranteed! Get ready, we have surprises waiting for you.
dinner.description: Join us for an unforgettable dinner!

teasers.challenges_text: At the start of the dinner, challenges will be available on our website. Complete the challenge, show the staff, and earn an extra drink token!
teasers.contests_text: After dinner, show what you've got in our contests and get a chance to win tokens or assorted prizes!
teasers.titles_text: Vote for your peers! During the dinner, elect your friend to receive a title.
teasers.karaoke_text: Show off your skills on the mic! Solo or in a group, brave karaoke singers get tokens ;)

surprises.title: Course Dinner Surprises
surprises.welcome_message:
Welcome to the course dinner!
Explore all the activities we prepared for you:

cartas.title: Cards
cartas.description:
During check-in, each person receives a card.
 Find who has the matching card and head to the staff together to both receive a drink token.

votacoes.title: Voting
votacoes.text: Vote for the most iconic titles!
votacoes.description:
During dinner you can vote in special categories like “Vibe Coder”, “Crypto Bro”, “Ghost” and many more.
 Winners receive special sashes at the end of the night.

story.title: NEIIST Story
story.text: Post a story and get a drink!
story.description: Post a photo or video of the dinner on Instagram, tag @neiist and keep the story up for at least 1 hour. Then show the staff to get your token.

posters.title: Poster Bugs
posters.description: There are posters scattered around the venue — some have hidden bugs. Find posters with errors and show the staff to get a token.

tux.title: Find Tux
tux.description: There will be a giant banner with a hidden Tux. The first people to find it receive a token. Take a photo and show the staff.

stickers.title: NEIIST Stickers
stickers.description: There are NEIIST stickers hidden around the venue. If you find one, bring it to the staff and get a token.

outfit.title: Embarrassing Outfit
outfit.description: Wear one of the embarrassing t-shirts or accessories available during dinner and get a token for your courage.

chambel.title: Challenge Chambel
chambel.description: Challenge Chambel to a quick mental math game or programming challenge. If you win, you get a token.

flex.title: Arm Wrestling
flex.description: Participate in the arm wrestling tournament at the dinner and prove that computer scientists have strength too.

futsal.title: Futsal Shot
futsal.description: Show your aim on the mini goal. Each shot in the corner earns a token.

karaoke.title: Karaoke
karaoke.text: Sing at the top of your lungs!
karaoke.description: Take the stage and sing your favorite song. The bravest singers receive drink tokens.

spotify.title: Dinner Playlist
spotify.description: Listen to all the songs in our official course dinner playlist and add your favorites.

hero.title: Computer Science Student Branch at Instituto Superior Técnico

sinfo.title: Autonomous Section
sinfo.description: SINFO is an annual event organized exclusively by students who strive to make the event more interesting and innovative with each edition. All participants have the opportunity to experience some of the most innovative gadgets and technologies on the market, in addition to being presented with an overview of the IT landscape by top companies. On top of all this, daily workshops cover the most in-demand and recent topics, helping all participants enhance their technical and non-technical skills.
sinfo.objective: The main goal of SINFO is to allow all students and participants in general to interact and get closer to influential and inspiring people or companies in Information Technology and Computer Science.

aoc.title: Advent of Code
aoc.description: Advent of Code is an event featuring daily coding challenges from December 1st until Christmas. You can solve these challenges in any programming language you like! Whoever scores the most points by the end wins!

esports.title: E-Sports Tournament
esports.description: Do you love gaming? What a coincidence, this event was tailor-made for you! Gather a team and spend the day with us gaming, eating, drinking... and maybe winning a prize or two!

sweats.title: CS Sweatshirts
sweats.description: How about having a hoodie with your degree's name? Don't forget, NEIIST gives you the opportunity to wear the sweatshirt of the best degree!

layout.title: Sweatshirt Layout Contest
layout.description: The Sweatshirt Layout Contest is your chance to design the official look for each year's special edition. If you are an IST CS student, you can submit up to 3 original designs. If you win the online vote, you win the sweatshirt!

churras.title: CS Barbecue
churras.description: Even in the midst of project deadlines or exam weeks, there's always time to hang out with friends!

jantar_curso.title: Course Dinner
jantar_curso.description: Stressed out with Técnico? Us too! Join your peers for the best course dinner of the year! The drinks are waiting for you...

ltal.title: Let's Talk about LEIC
ltal.description: Just arrived at the degree and feeling lost? Come learn all the survival tips with us! In this event, senior students help you understand how LEIC works and navigate its courses.

qtsm.title: (Almost) Everything About MEIC
qtsm.description: Starting your Master's in MEIC? If you're undecided about which specialization or courses to pick, join these sessions! We'll explain the degree structure, curriculum, thesis details, and more.

python.title: Python Workshop
python.description: Worried about your intro programming project or eager to master Python? Join this workshop where we cover fundamental programming concepts and teach essential first steps in computing!

assembly.title: Assembly Workshop
assembly.description: Wondering what MOV, ADD, CMP mean? Unsure about registers and flags? Join us in this workshop where we teach you the Assembly foundations essential for Computer Architecture!

c.title: C Workshop
c.description: Want to finally understand memory allocation, pointers, stack operations, and more? Join us in this workshop and clear all your doubts!

hashcode.title: Hash Code
hashcode.description: Join us in the Google coding competition where NEIIST hosts a Hub where all Técnico students are welcome to participate and compete.

lip.title: Linux Install Party
lip.description: Come install Linux on your laptop with the guidance of experienced students who will help you set up and explore the diverse Linux distributions!

footer.mission_description: A group of motivated students committed to helping every Computer Science and Engineering student, organizing activities and social support.

hero.title: Who We Are?
hero.description: The NEIIST team consists of {count} students from Instituto Superior Técnico, motivated to support all students interested in diverse computing fields. Founded in 2004, all NEIIST members dedicate their time and effort to organizing a wide range of activities that help our academic community thrive. Our goal is to foster enthusiasm for Computer Science, connecting students, professors, and companies while promoting technical and personal growth. Our vision is to be a beacon of support and integration for students in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

join_us.title: Join Us!
join_us.description:
NEIIST is recruiting for the 1st Phase 26/27! Come develop your soft skills and contribute to our community by joining one of our teams External Relations, Human Resources, Dev-Team, Logistics, Marketing & Design.
Register until September 30th (23:59).
